causes.label: Control in OFF position.
remedies: Move the control to a temperature setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Control in OFF position."

causes.label: Refrigerator is unplugged.
remedies: Push the plug completely into the outlet.

causes.label: The fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped.
remedies: Replace fuse or reset the breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "The fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped."

symptoms.symptom: Vibration or rattling (slight vibration is normal)

causes.label: Front leveling legs (on some models) need adjusting.
remedies: See Leveling Legs.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Front leveling legs (on some models) need adjusting."

causes.label: Refrigerator is on an uneven surface.
remedies: Use shims to level the refrigerator.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Refrigerator is on an uneven surface."

causes.label: Refrigerator is locked (lock is available on some models).
remedies: Unlock the door with the key.
If the key has been lost, a replacement key can be ordered by visiting our Website ge.com, or calling GE Parts and Accessories, 800.626.2002.
Order part WR05X10006.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Refrigerator is locked (lock is available on some models)."

causes.label: Temperature control not set cold enough.
remedies: See About the control.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Temperature control not set cold enough."

causes.label: Warm weather or frequent door openings.
remedies: Set the temperature control one step colder.
See About the control.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Warm weather or frequent door openings."

causes.label: Door left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding door open.

causes.label: Cabinet sides are warm (applies only to 2, 3 and 4 Cubic Foot Models).
remedies: This is normal for a hot wall type condenser.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Cabinet sides are warm (applies only to 2, 3 and 4 Cubic Foot Models)."

causes.label: Red defrost button was pushed accidentally (on push button models).
remedies: See IMPORTANT: text in Defrosting under Care and Cleaning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Red defrost button was pushed accidentally (on push button models)."

causes.label: Foods transmitting odor to refrigerator.
remedies: Foods with strong odors should be tightly wrapped.
Keep an open box of baking soda in the refrigerator; replace every three months.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Foods transmitting odor to refrigerator."

causes.label: Interior needs cleaning.
remedies: See Care and cleaning.

causes.label: Defrost water pan needs cleaning.
remedies: See Care and cleaning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Defrost water pan needs cleaning."

symptoms.symptom: Moisture forms on outside of refrigerator

causes.label: Not unusual during periods of high humidity.
remedies: Wipe surface dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Not unusual during periods of high humidity."

symptoms.symptom: Moisture collects inside (in humid weather, air carries moisture into refrigerator when door is opened)

causes.label: Too frequent or too long door openings.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Too frequent or too long door openings."

causes.label: Temperature control set too cold.
remedies: See About the control.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 13: "Temperature control set too cold."
